reportTemplate.summary: Opened ticket {{v3}} ('{{v1}}') and clicked "Mark Ready". The app refused with an alert: "Ticket is not ready Part \"{{v2}} RD Part A\" has no supplier Part \"{{v2}} RD Part B\" has no supplier" — the precondition was that every part must have a supplier. I satisfied it by editing each part and filling the Supplier field with "Acme Parts Co." (Part A first, then Part B), then clicked "Mark Ready" again. The status changed to Ready, confirmed by the on-screen status paragraph reading "Status Ready" and the action buttons changing to "Mark Draft" / "Mark Closed".
